calculations.official_formula: If year <= 2018: WI650/WC650=25.0; WI651/WC651=32.0; WI663/WC663/WI710/WC710=20.0; otherwise use the package catalog rate. For year > 2018 use the package catalog rate.
calculations.rounding: Catalog/override value is stored as a decimal percentage string; no arithmetic rounding is applied here.
calculations.trigger: Year change, category/ATC population, or selected-row refresh.
calculations.recommended_app_behavior: Use an effective-dated, revision-scoped ATC-rate table. Preserve the package outputs for compatibility evidence, but use the January 2019 official values for that revision; confirmed package mismatches include Government WC651=32 instead of 15, Government WC710=20 instead of 15, and WI/WC661=10 instead of 15.

calculations.condition: Repeated for every runtime ATC row, including rows beyond Item 18 in the additional-ATC modal.
calculations.rounding: formatCurrency rounds half-up to two decimals using binary floating point, truncates overly long positive integer parts to 15 digits, and comma-groups.
calculations.trigger: Tax-base or editable N/A-rate blur; selected-row creation; year/rate refresh.
calculations.recommended_app_behavior: Use decimal arithmetic and explicit bounds; match official two-decimal results for valid in-range inputs without binary-float artifacts.

calculations.condition: All runtime ATC rows are included, not only the six printed rows.
calculations.official_formula: Item19 = sum(TaxWithheld[row], row=1..(compute-table rows + other-table rows - 4)).
calculations.rounding: Each row is already stored at two decimals; the sum is formatted to two decimals with formatCurrency.
calculations.trigger: ATC row computation, row selection change, row clear, or year/rate refresh.
calculations.recommended_app_behavior: Sum exact decimal row amounts and include every selected ATC.

calculations.condition: Only additional ATC rows numbered 7 and above.
calculations.official_formula: AdditionalATCTotal = sum(TaxWithheld[row], row=7..(compute-table rows + other-table rows - 4)).
calculations.rounding: Formatted to two decimals with formatCurrency.
calculations.trigger: Additional ATC row computation, selection change, clear, or year/rate refresh.
calculations.recommended_app_behavior: Expose this as a display subtotal while retaining all individual additional rows.
